get.description:
Return a human-readable readiness message for the frontend.

Returns:
    A typed status response confirming that the API is ready.

post.description: Verify credentials and issue a fresh access token.
post.summary: Log in to an existing account

post.description:
Create one account and issue its first access token.

The role chosen here is embedded in future verified JWTs; roles never
come from any other request body.

get.description: List every course the authenticated professor owns.

schema.title: Response List Courses Api V1 Courses Get

post.description: Create one course owned by the authenticated professor.

delete.description: Delete one owned course and its lecture records.

get.description: Return one course for its owner.

post.description: Requires APP_ENV=demo; no JWT needed because all data is synthetic and isolated. Optional empty JSON body only. Returns a sourced mock card, anonymous reports and an input-only heuristic cost illustration. No provider calls or persistent session IDs. Non-demo access: 404; invalid fields: 422; oversized body: 413; generation failure: 502.
Mint a short-lived token for a named synthetic actor.
post.summary: Mint a synthetic demo access token

get.description: List the authenticated user's course enrollments, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Enrollments Api V1 Enrollments Get

post.description:
Enroll the authenticated student in the course using the shared code.

Enrollment lets the desktop app detect the course's future live lectures
and offer a one-click join. Students only; re-enrolling is idempotent.
Returns ``not_found`` for unknown codes and ``duplicate`` when the code is
ambiguous across professors.
post.summary: Enroll in a course by course code

delete.description: Remove one owned enrollment so its lectures are no longer detected.

patch.description:
Toggle whether live lectures for the course join without a prompt.

Auto-join is off by default because joining also opts the student into
anonymous aggregation; the student must enable it explicitly.

get.description: List lecture records for one course the professor owns.

schema.title: Response List Lectures Api V1 Lectures Get

post.description: Create one lecture record inside a course the professor owns.

get.description: Return one lecture record for its owner.

List the authenticated professor's sessions with optional filters.

Only professors can access this ownership-scoped list. Students receive a
forbidden error. Results are ordered newest first by session start time.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Sessions Get

post.description:
Start one running occurrence of a lecture on the shared clock.

The authenticated user becomes the session owner. The ``lecture_id``
identifies the lecture record and the returned ``session_id`` identifies
this occurrence.

get.description:
List active sessions matched to the student by enrollment or Zoom meeting.

A session is included when its course is one of the caller's enrollments
or when ``zoom_meeting_id`` equals the session's Zoom meeting id. Each
match reports whether the caller already joined and whether the enrollment
allows joining without a prompt. Results are newest first.

schema.title: Response List Available Sessions Api V1 Sessions Available Get

get.summary: List live sessions I can join without a code

get.description:
Resolve a student-entered code to an active lecture session.

Authentication is required, but the lookup is not restricted to session
membership. Whitespace and lowercase input are normalized. Unknown codes
and codes for inactive sessions return a not-found error.
Return the session for an authenticated owner, participant, or professor.

put.description: JWT participant changes only their own aggregation consent. Withdrawal removes coverage and affects every subsequent report. It does not change external text consent.

post.description: JWT card owner confirms create-only export to their selected folder. Accepts a card reference, not arbitrary text or raw media. Mock receipts do not imply live Dropbox success.

put.description: JWT member selects their own authorized course folder. Default destination is synthetic in demo/test only.

get.description: Return recorded provider usage, labeled synthetic in mock mode.

schema.title: Response Read Cost Metrics Api V1 Sessions  Session Id  Cost Metrics Get

get.summary: List cost metrics for the session

post.description: JWT student membership and current aggregation consent required. Accepts bounded availability intervals only. Exact retries are duplicates; conflicting batches are atomic. No raw media or identity claims.
Course-professor JWT required. Accepts only local derived delivery events. Frames, boxes, file paths and student identity are forbidden. Conflicts reject the entire batch.
Session-owner JWT required. End the session idempotently; late student and delivery observations are rejected.

Ingest coarse, timestamped missed-content signal events.

Raw webcam frames, continuous raw audio, and screenshots are never
accepted; unexpected fields are rejected by contract validation.
post.summary: Ingest a batch of signal events

post.description: Apply the student's confirmation or denial of missed content.

put.description: JWT member updates only their own provider-specific permission. Separate from signal/aggregation consent. Revocation clears their recovery cache; previously exported external copies are not deleted.

post.description:
Opt the authenticated user into anonymous, aggregated participation.

Students are also enrolled in the session's course so future lectures of
that course can be detected and offered as a one-click join.

get.description: Authorized course professor, ended session and configured policy required. Returns fixed buckets with safe counts or suppression; unknown coverage is never healthy continuity. Phone observations are excluded.

post.description: Course-professor JWT and released evidence required. Mock by default; live mode additionally requires external-text consent. Recommendations cite approved aggregate intervals; raw and individual signals never reach the provider.

put.description: Course-professor JWT required. Store reviewed/dismissed/resolved state against a current report revision. Stale evidence returns a conflict.

get.description:
Return an anonymous, aggregated summary for the course professor.

Aggregates are suppressed below the configured minimum group size and
never include student identifiers or individual confidence values.

post.description:
Recover missed content for ``[start_ms, end_ms)`` in one session.

Supplying an ``Idempotency-Key`` header makes the request safe to retry:
the same key returns the original job instead of creating a duplicate.
